name: Chitrakote Waterfalls (Niagara of India)
price_unit: free scenic viewing (Local boat ride to mist base ₹100)
opening_hours: Sunrise to Sunset daily (Floodlights illuminate the cascade at night)
best_time: July to October (monsoon peak where the waterfall spans nearly 1,000 feet wide)
rules: Boating to the thunderous spray base available in wooden country boats with life-jackets
visual_features: monumental 980-foot wide horseshoe-shaped waterfall roaring over a 95-foot vertical sandstone cliff on the Indravati river amidst lush sal jungles
description: The Chitrakote Falls is a natural waterfall on the Indravati River, located approximately 38 kilometres (24 mi) to the west of Jagdalpur, in Bastar district in the Indian state of Chhattisgarh.
